Create multiple objects of the specified kind from a YAML file.



The file should contain a YAML array of objects:

- kind: backlog_item

title: "Item 1"

...

- kind: backlog_item

title: "Item 2"

...



Optional --fields restricts each successful created object in JSON/YAML output
to those top-level keys

(same hybrid projection as object list / get).

  Create multiple backlog items from file
  zqk object bulk create backlog_item --file items.yaml
  Dry-run to see what would be created
  zqk object bulk create backlog_item --file items.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk object bulk create <kind> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be done without actually doing it
      --fields stringArray      Top-level keys per successful object in output (hybrid projection; post-create).
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing array of objects (required)
      --force                   Force mode: update existing objects instead of failing if they already exist
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --relaxed                 Relax integrity constraints during bulk creation (allow references to objects that will be created later in batch operations). Note: Auto-detected for bulk operations, this flag is optional.
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
